name: Ledger Nano Gen5 case
description: Replacement case for a bare Ledger Nano Gen5 board, in two parts: a bezel with a screen window and four screw posts, and a tray that closes the back (with openings for the USB-C port and the side button) and snaps onto the bezel without screws. Like the original case, the board is screwed to the bezel: put the board face-down onto the posts and fix it from the back (battery side) with 4 small self-tapping screws (M2, placeholder), then press the tray on from behind until the hooks click into the grooves in its long walls. Print the tray floor-down and the bezel face-down (posts and hooks up) in PLA at 100% scale with a 0.4 mm nozzle, 0.2 mm layers and supports off. The board dimensions, screw size and screw positions are placeholders and the fit has not been tested yet: measure the board and adjust the parameters in generate.py before printing, and test the snap fit before putting the board in.
